newsitem.title: USA: Park-Ohio Industries commences tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Park-Ohio Industries commences tender offer.

text.p: Park-Ohio Industries Inc said on Thursday it has commenced its cash tender offer for all the outstanding shares of Arden Industrial Products Inc's common stock as part of its previously announced merger plan.
Under the offer, shareholders who tender their shares will be entitled to receive $6.00 in cash per share. The offer and withdrawal rights are set to expire at 1700 EDT on July 25.
The total value of the deal is estimated at about $42 million.
Arden is a national distributor of specialty and standard fasteners to the industrial market. Park-Ohio is a diversified manufacturing and logistics company.
